stem: How did President Richard Nixon’s visit to China in 1972 represent a change in U.S. foreign relations?

options.label: A
options.text: It showed that the United States recognized Taiwan as the head of Chinese government.

options.label: B
options.text: It showed that the United States had abandoned its interests in Asia.

options.label: C
options.text: It was a sign that the United States accepted China as an influential country in the region.

options.label: D
options.text: It was a sign that the United States had decided to provide military support to Taiwan.
